overall: The AG found no violation: the Town Clerk posted the October 22, 2020 notice on the official bulletin board more than 48 hours ahead. The website-timing claim was not reached and the non-clickable Zoom link claim was declined.

allegations.summary: The complainant alleged the Committee did not post notice 48 hours before its October 22, 2020 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: the bulletin board outside town hall is the official notice posting location for all Mattapoisett public bodies, including the Committee

allegations.summary: The complainant alleged the October 22 meeting was not posted to the Committee's website until less than 48 hours before the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: there is no requirement that a meeting notice be posted to the website

allegations.summary: The complainant alleged the Zoom link in the October 22 meeting notice was not clickable.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we decline to review this allegation.
